en.t: Germanic Wars: An alliance of Germanic tribes led by Arminius engaged Roman forces at the Battle of the Teutoburg Forest, defeating three legions within a few days
en.s: The Battle of the Teutoburg Forest, also called the Varian Disaster (Latin: Clades Variana) by Roman historians, was a major battle fought between an alliance of Germanic peoples and the Roman Empire between 8 and 11 September 9 CE, possibly near modern Kalkriese. Fighting began with an ambush by the Germanic alliance on three Roman legions being led by Publius Quinctilius Varus and their auxiliaries; the alliance was led by Arminius, a Germanic chieftain and officer of Varus's auxilia.

zh.t: 日耳曼战争：阿米尼乌斯率部在条顿堡森林与罗马军交战，数日内击败三个军团
zh.s: 条顿堡森林战役也称瓦卢斯灾难（拉丁语：Clades Variana），是日耳曼部族联盟与罗马帝国之间的一场重要战役。战斗于公元9年9月8日至11日进行，地点可能在今卡尔克里泽附近。日耳曼部族联盟伏击了普布利乌斯·昆克蒂利乌斯·瓦卢斯率领的三个罗马军团及其辅助部队，战斗由此打响。联盟由日耳曼首领阿米尼乌斯率领；他曾在瓦卢斯的辅助部队中任职。

en.s: Constantius II (Latin: Flavius Julius Constantius; Ancient Greek: Κωνστάντιος, romanized: Kōnstántios; 7 August 317 – 3 November 361) was Roman emperor from 337 to 361. His reign saw constant warfare on the borders against the Sasanian Empire and Germanic peoples, while internally the Roman Empire went through repeated civil wars, court intrigues, and usurpations. His religious policies inflamed domestic conflicts that would continue after his death.

zh.t: 君士坦提乌斯二世即位
zh.s: 君士坦提乌斯二世（拉丁语：Flavius Julius Constantius；古希腊语：Κωνστάντιος；317年8月7日—361年11月3日）于337年至361年担任罗马皇帝。在他统治期间，罗马帝国边境持续与萨珊帝国和日耳曼诸族交战，国内则反复发生内战、宫廷阴谋和篡位事件。他的宗教政策激化了国内冲突，这些冲突在他去世后仍持续。

en.s: The Battle of Krbava Field (Croatian: Bitka na Krbavskom polju, Hungarian: Korbávmezei csata, Turkish: Krbava Muharebesi) was fought between the Ottoman Empire of Bayezid II and an army of the Kingdom of Croatia, at the time in personal union with the Kingdom of Hungary, on 9 September 1493, in the Krbava field, a part of the Lika region in Croatia. The Ottoman forces were under the command of Hadım Yakup Pasha, sanjak-bey of the Sanjak of Bosnia, and the Croatian army was led by Emerik Derenčin, Ban of Croatia, who served under King Vladisluas II Jagiello.

en.s: The Battle of Flodden or Flodden Field, or occasionally Battle of Branxton (Brainston Moor), was part of a conflict between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland. The battle was fought in the county of Northumberland in northern England on 9 September 1513, between an invading Scots army under King James IV and an English army commanded by the Earl of Surrey. It was a decisive English victory. In terms of troop numbers, it was the largest battle fought between the two Kingdoms. James IV was killed in the battle, becoming the last monarch from the island of Great Britain to suffer such a death.

zh.s: 弗洛登战役也称弗洛登原野战役，偶尔也称布兰克斯顿战役，是英格兰王国与苏格兰王国之间冲突的一部分。1513年9月9日，英格兰北部诺森伯兰郡爆发战斗，入侵英格兰的苏格兰军队由詹姆斯四世国王率领，英军则由萨里伯爵指挥。英军取得决定性胜利。按参战人数计算，这是两国之间规模最大的一场战役。詹姆斯四世在战斗中阵亡，成为不列颠岛上最后一位战死的君主。

en.t: Mary Stuart, at nine months old, is crowned "Queen of Scots" in the central Scottish town of Stirling
en.s: Mary, Queen of Scots (8 December 1542 – 8 February 1587), also known as Mary Stuart or Mary I of Scotland, was Queen of Scotland from 14 December 1542 until her forced abdication on 24 July 1567. The only surviving legitimate child of King James V of Scotland, Mary was six days old when her father died, and she inherited the throne.

zh.t: 苏格兰女王玛丽九个月大时在斯特灵加冕
zh.s: 苏格兰女王玛丽（1542年12月8日—1587年2月8日）又称玛丽·斯图亚特或苏格兰的玛丽一世，自1542年12月14日起担任苏格兰女王，直至1567年7月24日被迫退位。她是苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世唯一在世的合法子女；父亲去世时她只有6天大，随后继承王位。

en.s: Thomas Cavendish's circumnavigation was a voyage of raid and exploration by English navigator and sailor Thomas Cavendish which took place during the Anglo–Spanish War between 21 July 1586 and 9 September 1588. Following in the footsteps of Francis Drake who circumnavigated the globe, Thomas Cavendish was influenced in an attempt to repeat the feat. As such it was the first deliberately planned voyage of the globe.

en.s: The Stono Rebellion (sometimes called Cato's Conspiracy or Cato's Rebellion) was a slave rebellion that began on 9 September 1739, in the colony of South Carolina. It was the largest slave uprising in the British mainland colonies, with 42-47 whites and 44 blacks killed. The uprising was led by native Africans who were likely from the Central African Kingdom of Kongo. Some of the rebels spoke Portuguese. Their leader Jemmy was a literate slave; in some reports he is referred to as "Cato", and likely was held by the Cato, or Cater, family who lived near the Ashley River and north of the Stono River.

zh.s: 斯托诺起义有时也称卡托阴谋或卡托起义，是南卡罗来纳殖民地于1739年9月9日爆发的一场奴隶起义。这是英国在北美大陆殖民地发生的规模最大的一次奴隶起义，造成42至47名白人和44名黑人死亡。起义由来自非洲的奴隶领导，他们可能来自中非的刚果王国。一些起义者会说葡萄牙语。起义领袖杰米是一名识字的奴隶；一些记载称他为“卡托”。他可能曾被阿什利河附近、斯托诺河北面的卡托（或凯特）家族奴役。

en.t: Amalthea becomes the last moon to be discovered without the use of photography
en.s: Amalthea () is a moon of Jupiter. It has the third-closest orbit around Jupiter among known moons and was the fifth moon of Jupiter to be discovered, so it is also known as Jupiter V. It is also the fifth-largest moon of Jupiter, after the four Galilean moons. Edward Emerson Barnard discovered the moon on 9 September 1892 and named it after Amalthea of Greek mythology.

en.s: The Battle of Ginchy took place on 9 September 1916 during the Battle of the Somme, when the 16th Division captured the German-held village. Ginchy is 1.5 kilometres (0.93 mi) north-east of Guillemont, at the junction of six roads on a rise overlooking Combles, 4 kilometres (2.5 mi) to the south-east. After the conclusion of the Battle of Guillemont on 6 September, XIV Corps and XV Corps were required to complete the advance to positions which would give observation over the German third position, ready for a general attack in mid-September, for which the Anglo-French armies had been preparing since early August.

zh.s: 金希战役于1916年9月9日爆发，是索姆河战役的一部分。英军第16师攻占了由德军控制的村庄金希。该村位于吉耶蒙东北1.5公里处，坐落在俯瞰孔布勒、通向六条道路的高地上。9月6日吉耶蒙战役结束后，第十四军和第十五军奉命继续推进到能观察德军第三道防线的位置，为英法联军筹备已久、定于9月中旬发动的总攻作准备。

en.s: The Turkish capture of Smyrna or the Liberation of İzmir (Turkish: İzmir'in Kurtuluşu) marked the end of the 1919–1922 Greco-Turkish War, and the culmination of the Turkish War of Independence. On 9 September 1922, following the headlong retreat of the Greek army after its defeat at the Battle of Dumlupınar and its evacuation from western Anatolia, the Turkish 5th Cavalry Corps under the command of Major-General Fahrettin Altay within the Turkish Army under the command of Mustafa Kemal Pasha marched into the city of Smyrna (modern İzmir), bringing three years of Greek occupation to an end.

zh.s: 土耳其攻占士麦那，也称伊兹密尔解放（突厥语：İzmir'in Kurtuluşu），标志着1919年至1922年希土战争结束，也是土耳其独立战争的高潮。1922年9月9日，希腊军队在杜姆卢珀纳尔战役中败北后迅速撤退，并撤离安纳托利亚西部。随后，法赫雷丁·阿尔泰少将指挥的土耳其第5骑兵军，在穆斯塔法·凯末尔帕夏指挥的土耳其陆军编制下进入士麦那（今伊兹密尔），结束了希腊对该城长达3年的占领。

en.t: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, the founder of the Republic of Turkey, founds the Republican People's Party
en.s: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk (c. 1881 – 10 November 1938) was a Turkish field marshal and statesperson who was the founder of the Republic of Turkey and served as its first president from 1923 until his death in 1938. He led sweeping reforms, turning Turkey into an industrialising nation. Ideologically a republican, secularist, and nationalist, his policies and socio-political theories became known as Kemalism.

en.s: The Lookout Air Raids were minor but historic Japanese air raids that occurred in the mountains of Oregon, several miles outside Brookings during World War II. This was the only time during World War II that the 48 contiguous United States suffered an air raid attack by enemy forces. On September 9, 1942, a Japanese Yokosuka E14Y Glen floatplane, launched from a Japanese submarine, dropped two incendiary bombs with the intention of starting a forest fire.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，日本曾在俄勒冈州布鲁金斯镇外数英里的山区实施规模较小、但具有历史意义的空袭。这是二战期间美国本土48州唯一一次遭敌方空袭。1942年9月9日，一架从日本潜艇上起飞的横须贺E14Y“格伦”水上飞机投下两枚燃烧弹，企图引发森林火灾。

en.s: The Battle of Mission Ridge–Brigade Hill (also known as the Battle of Efogi) took place between 6 and 9 September 1942, during the Kokoda Track campaign of the Second World War. Involving forces from Australia, the United States, and Japan, the fighting centred on a high feature south of the village of Efogi on the Kokoda Track.

zh.s: 米申岭—旅团山战役也称埃福吉战役，于1942年9月6日至9日爆发，是第二次世界大战科科达小径战役的一部分。澳大利亚、美国和日本军队在埃福吉村以南的高地交战，战斗主要围绕这一地势较高的地点展开。

en.s: Operation Avalanche was the codename for the Allied landings near the port of Salerno, executed on 9 September 1943, part of the Allied invasion of Italy during World War II. The Italians withdrew from the war the day before the invasion, but the Allies landed in an area defended by German troops. Planned under the name Top Hat, it was supported by the deception plan Operation Boardman.

en.s: Operation Slapstick was the code name for a British landing from the sea at the Italian port of Taranto during the Second World War. The operation, one of three landings during the Allied invasion of Italy in September 1943, was undertaken by airborne troops of the British 1st Airborne Division, commanded by Major-General George Hopkinson.

en.s: The Battle of Radovychi (Ukrainian: Битва під Радовичами, 7–9 September 1943) was one the largest battles between Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA) and German forces during World War II. It took place near the village of Radovychi in Volyn Oblast, Ukraine. Around 1,000 Ukrainian partisans defeated 1,570 Germans.

en.s: The action off Bastia or battle of Bastia (battaglia di Bastia in Italian; bataille navale de Pietracorbara in French) was a naval engagement fought on 9 September 1943 between German vessels and Italian ships and coastal artillery. Bastia is the main port of Corsica in the Ligurian Sea. Secret negotiations between the Italian government and the Allies led to the Armistice of Cassibile (3 September 1943) and the defection of Italy from the Axis.

zh.s: 巴斯蒂亚海战也称巴斯蒂亚战役（意大利语：battaglia di Bastia；法语：bataille navale de Pietracorbara），于1943年9月9日爆发，交战双方是德国舰艇、意大利船只和海岸炮兵。巴斯蒂亚是科西嘉岛在利古里亚海沿岸的主要港口。意大利政府与盟军秘密谈判后，于9月3日签署《卡西比莱停战协定》，随后意大利脱离轴心国。

en.s: The Bulgarian coup d'état of 1944, also known as the 9 September coup d'état (Bulgarian: Деветосептемврийски преврат, Devetoseptemvriyski prevrat) and called in pre-1989 Bulgaria the National Uprising of 9 September or the Socialist Revolution of 9 September, was a change in the Kingdom of Bulgaria's administration and government carried out on the eve of 9 September 1944. The government of Prime Minister Konstantin Muraviev was overthrown and replaced with a government of the Fatherland Front led by Kimon Georgiev. While the Soviet Union supported the coup, their forces (the Third Ukrainian Front) were not directly involved in it, as they had only entered northeastern Bulgaria at this point.

zh.s: 1944年保加利亚政变又称“9月9日政变”（保加利亚语：Деветосептемврийски преврат），在1989年前的保加利亚也称“9月9日民族起义”或“9月9日社会主义革命”。1944年9月9日前夕，保加利亚王国政府发生更迭：康斯坦丁·穆拉维耶夫总理领导的政府被推翻，基蒙·格奥尔基耶夫领导的祖国阵线政府接替执政。苏联支持这次政变，但苏军（乌克兰第三方面军）并未直接参与，当时其部队刚进入保加利亚东北部。

It resulted in ELAS' victory and the liberation of Kalamata. After the battle, members of the Nazi collaborators were killed by the crowd.

en.s: The Second Sino-Japanese War was fought between the Republic of China and the Empire of Japan and its puppet states between 1937 and 1945, following a period of conflict localized to Manchuria that started in 1931. zh.s: 第二次中日战争是中华民国与日本帝国及其傀儡政权之间的战争，持续于1937年至1945年。此前，双方自1931年起已在满洲地区发生局部冲突。这场战争常被视为第二次世界大战在亚洲的开端；日本袭击美国后，两场战争紧密交织。

en.s: The Postribë Uprising (Albanian: Kryengritja e Postribës), also known as the Postrib Movement (Albanian: Lëvizja e Postribës), was an anti-communist armed uprising in Albania on September 9, 1946. en.s: The 1954 Chlef earthquake struck El Asnam Province in French Algeria on 9 September at 02:04:43 local time. The shock measured 6.7 on the moment magnitude scale and had a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme). It destroyed Chlef, then named Orléansville, leaving over 1,243 people dead and 5,000 injured. Damage was estimated at $6 million. It was followed by multiple aftershocks.

en.s: Hurricane Betsy was an intense, deadly and destructive tropical cyclone that brought widespread damage to areas of Florida, the Bahamas, and the central United States Gulf Coast in September 1965. The storm's erratic nature, coupled with its intensity and minimal preparation time contributed to making Betsy the first tropical cyclone in the Atlantic basin to accrue at least $1 billion in damage.
en.n: Hurricane Betsy makes its second landfall near New Orleans, leaving 76 dead and $1.42 billion ($10–12 billion in 2005 dollars) in damages, becoming the first hurricane to cause over $1 billion in unadjusted damage.

zh.s: 飓风贝齐是1965年9月袭击佛罗里达州、巴哈马群岛和美国墨西哥湾沿岸中部地区的强烈风暴，造成大量人员伤亡和财产损失。风暴路线多变、威力强，而且准备时间很短；它造成至少10亿美元损失，成为大西洋盆地首个达到这一损失规模的热带气旋。

en.s: Operation Raviv (Hebrew: רביב, Drizzle), also known in Egypt as the Zaafarana accident (Arabic: حادثة الزعفرانة) or the Ten-Hour War, was a mounted raid conducted by the Israeli Defence Forces (IDF) on Egypt's Red Sea coast during the War of Attrition. Taking place on September 9, 1969, Raviv was the sole major ground offensive undertaken by the IDF against Egypt throughout the war.

zh.s: 拉维夫行动（希伯来语：רביב，意为“细雨”），在埃及也称扎法拉纳事件（阿拉伯语：حادثة الزعفرانة）或“十小时战争”，是以色列国防军在消耗战争期间对埃及红海沿岸发动的一次装甲突袭。行动于1969年9月9日展开，是整个消耗战争期间以军对埃及发动的唯一一次重大地面攻势。

en.t: In Canada, the Official Languages Act comes into force, making French equal to English throughout the Federal government
en.s: The Official Languages Act (French: Loi sur les langues officielles) is a Canadian law that came into force on September 9, 1969, which gives French and English equal status in the government of Canada. This makes them "official" languages, having preferred status in law over all other languages. Although the Official Languages Act is not the only piece of federal language law, it is the legislative keystone of Canada's official bilingualism.

en.t: Imagine is the second solo studio album by the English musician John Lennon, released on 9 September 1971 by Apple Records
en.s: Imagine is the second solo studio album by the English musician John Lennon, released on 9 September 1971 by Apple Records. en.t: In Kentucky's Mammoth Cave National Park, a Cave Research Foundation exploration and mapping team discovers a link between the Mammoth and Flint Ridge cave systems, making it the longest known cave passageway in the world
en.s: Mammoth Cave National Park is a national park of the United States in south-central Kentucky. It encompasses portions of Mammoth Cave, the longest known cave system in the world. The park's 52,007 acres (21,046 ha) are located primarily in Edmonson County, with small areas extending eastward into Hart and Barren counties. The Green River runs through the park, with a tributary called the Nolin River feeding into the Green just inside the park.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Belarus on 9 September 2001. Lukashenko was handily reelected with 77.4% of the vote over two minor candidates. Voter turnout was 83.9%. en.s: On 9 September 2001, Ahmad Shah Massoud was assassinated by two al-Qaeda operatives posing as journalists in Khwaja Bahauddin District, Takhar Province, Afghanistan. en.s: STS-115 was a Space Shuttle mission to the International Space Station (ISS) flown by Space Shuttle Atlantis. en.s: The 2010 Norwich City Council election took place on 9 September 2010 to elect members of Norwich City Council in England. One third of seats were up for election. The elections took place later in the year than other local elections. Norwich had previously been granted permission to become a unitary authority, with local elections postponed until 2011. When the Coalition Government won the general election earlier that year, Nowich's permission to form a unitary authority was overturned. Because of this, the High Court ruled that those councillors who had stayed on beyond their four-year term were no longer constitutionally elected, and would need to seek re-election.

en.s: The Battle of Doan took place on 9 September 2011, during the War in Afghanistan, between forces of the Taliban and elements of the Afghan National Army accompanied by units of the Australian Army deployed under Operation Slipper. en.s: The 2012 Hong Kong Legislative Council election was held on 9 September 2012 for the 5th Legislative Council (LegCo) since the establishment of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. en.s: A parliamentary election was held in Norway on 8 and 9 September 2013. The centre-right coalition obtained 96 seats, while the incumbent red–green coalition government obtained 72 seats and the Green Party obtained one. zh.s: 2020年9月9日，埃塞俄比亚提格雷地区举行地方议会选举，直接违反了《1995年埃塞俄比亚宪法》。联邦政府因此认定选举非法。联邦政府此前曾通过联邦院宣布，因新冠疫情推迟原定于当年的全国大选。

en.s: The Battle of Myin Thar was an engagement between the Myanmar SAC junta and anti-coup forces in the village of Myin Thar, Gangaw Township, Magway Region. Tatmadaw forces raided the village two days after the National Unity Government called for a "people's defensive war" against the military. Yaw militias armed with improvised black powder rifles and grenade launchers heavily resisted until heavy artillery forced them to withdraw.

en.s: The 2023 Under-20 Intercontinental Cup (Spanish: Sub-20 Intercontinental 2023) was the second edition of the UEFA–CONMEBOL Under-20 Intercontinental Cup, a one-off football match organised by CONMEBOL and UEFA between the winners of the U-20 Copa Libertadores and UEFA Youth League. As host confederation, CONMEBOL was in charge of the main organization of this edition. The match was played on 9 September 2023 at La Bombonera stadium in Buenos Aires, Argentina, between the Argentine team Boca Juniors, the 2023 U-20 Copa Libertadores champions, and Dutch team AZ, the 2022–23 UEFA Youth League champions.

zh.s: 2023年U20洲际杯（西班牙语：Sub-20 Intercontinental 2023）是欧足联与南美足联举办的第二届U20洲际杯，由南美解放者杯U20冠军对阵欧洲青年联赛冠军，是一场单场决胜的足球比赛。南美足联作为主办方负责本届赛事的主要组织工作。比赛于2023年9月9日在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯的糖果盒球场举行，由2023年南美解放者杯U20冠军博卡青年队对阵2022–23赛季欧洲青年联赛冠军荷兰AZ队。

en.s: The 2023 Simpang Jeram by-election was a by-election held on 9 September 2023 for the Johor State Legislative Assembly seat of Simpang Jeram. It was called following the death of incumbent, Salahuddin Ayub on 23 July 2023. The by-election were held on the same day as the 2023 Pulai by-election. Salahuddin was a 2-term Member of Parliament for Pulai, and also 2-term Member of Johor State Assembly for Simpang Jeram, both since 2018.

zh.s: 柔佛州议会新邦杰拉姆选区于2023年9月9日举行补选。时任议员萨拉胡丁·阿尤布于同年7月23日去世，因此举行补选。当天也举行了2023年蒲莱选区补选。萨拉胡丁自2018年起连续两届担任蒲莱国会议员，也连续两届担任新邦杰拉姆州议员。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Maldives on Saturday, 9 September 2023, with a second round held on 30 September. Incumbent president Ibrahim Mohamed Solih was seeking re-election, after defeating the-then Speaker of the People's Majlis Mohamed Nasheed in the Maldivian Democratic Party primaries. People's National Congress candidate and Malé mayor Mohamed Muizzu won the election with 54% of the votes, defeating Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and becoming President-elect of the Maldives.

zh.s: 马尔代夫于2023年9月9日星期六举行总统选举，第二轮投票于9月30日举行。现任总统易卜拉欣·穆罕默德·索利希寻求连任。他此前在马尔代夫民主党初选中击败当时的人民议会议长穆罕默德·纳希德。人民全国大会候选人、马累市长穆罕默德·穆伊祖在第二轮投票中以54%的得票率击败索利希，当选下任总统。

en.s: Impact! 1000 was a professional wrestling television special produced by Impact Wrestling. The event took place on September 9, 2023 at the Westchester County Center in White Plains, New York, and aired on tape delay as a two-night special of the company's weekly television show, Impact!, on September 14 and September 21, 2023. As the name suggests, the event celebrated the show's 1000th episode.

zh.s: 《Impact!》第1000集是Impact Wrestling制作的一场职业摔角电视特别节目。活动于2023年9月9日在纽约州怀特普莱恩斯的威彻斯特县中心举行，随后剪辑为两集特别节目，于9月14日和21日延后播出。这场活动是为庆祝该节目播出第1000集而举办的。

en.s: Snap indirect presidential elections were held on 9 September 2023, in the unrecognized Republic of Artsakh. The President of the National Assembly of Artsakh acted as president until the election. The sole candidate, Samvel Shahramanyan, was elected in a 22–1 vote out of 23 deputies present. Several countries and supranational organizations, including the Council of Europe and the European Union, declared the elections as unlawful.

zh.s: 未获国际承认的阿尔察赫共和国于2023年9月9日举行提前的间接总统选举。选举前，由阿尔察赫国民议会议长代理总统。唯一候选人萨姆韦尔·沙赫拉马尼扬以22票对1票当选，投票时共有23名议员出席。欧洲委员会、欧盟等多个国家和国际组织称这场选举不合法。

Alberto Barbera, Venice's artistic director, acknowledged that the 2023 SAG-AFTRA strike was likely to impact the festival if it was not resolved in time, due to the strike rules that prevent all actors from taking part in any kind of promotional activities for their films.

en.s: As part of the Russian invasion of Ukraine, a battle took place between the Russian Armed Forces and the Armed Forces of Ukraine for control over the city of Krasnohorivka, 5 kilometers west of Donetsk city. Fighting began on 8 April 2024. By 1 August 2024, Russian forces essentially controlled the whole city aside from the northern outskirts. On 9 September 2024, Russian forces established complete control over the city.

en.s: The 2025 Virginia's 11th congressional district special election to determine the member of the United States House of Representatives for Virginia's 11th congressional district was held on September 9, 2025. The seat became vacant following the death of Democrat Gerry Connolly on May 21, 2025. The district was considered safely Democratic. Fairfax County Supervisor James Walkinshaw won the Democratic primary with 59% of the vote, defeating Irene Shin and Stella Pekarsky.

zh.t: 2025年弗吉尼亚州第11国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2025年9月9日，弗吉尼亚州第11国会选区举行特别选举，选出美国众议院议员。民主党众议员杰里·康诺利于2025年5月21日去世后，该席位出现空缺。该选区被认为稳属民主党。费尔法克斯县督察委员会成员詹姆斯·沃肯肖在民主党初选中获得59%的选票，击败艾琳·申和斯特拉·佩卡斯基。

en.s: Elections in Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU) in Dhaka University were held on 9 September 2025, which is the first major electoral decision marking student politics in Bangladesh after the July Revolution which ousted Sheikh Hasina and her party, the Awami League from power in 2024.

en.s: On 9 September 2025, during the Gaza war, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) conducted an airstrike in the Leqtaifiya district of Qatar's capital Doha, targeting the leadership of Hamas, housed in a Qatari government residential complex, as it met to discuss an active ceasefire proposal presented by the United States. The attack killed and injured Hamas members, Qatari security forces, and multiple civilians.

en.s: On September 9th 2025, at about 11:30 p.m. CEST, 19 to 23 unarmed military drones entered Poland's airspace after allegedly being launched from Russia. The incursion triggered a Quick Reaction Alert; the Polish Air Force and other NATO militaries scrambled aircraft. Up to four drones were confirmed to have been shot down, most by the Dutch Air Force. Poland's prime minister Donald Tusk said that the drones "posed a direct threat".

zh.t: 2025年俄罗斯无人机侵入波兰领空事件
zh.s: 2025年9月9日欧洲中部夏令时间约23:30，据称从俄罗斯发射的19至23架无武装军用无人机进入波兰领空。波兰随即启动快速反应警报，波兰空军及其他北约成员国军队紧急出动飞机。最多有4架无人机被确认击落，其中多数由荷兰空军击落。波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克表示，这些无人机构成了“直接威胁”。
